title: How I Fine Tune Your Medical Report Classifier, Step by Step

sections.label: 1 · CLEAN THE DATA AND LOCK AN HONEST TEST SET
sections.note: 800 rows is small, so every bad row costs real accuracy. The test set is set aside first, before anything else touches the data.

sections.label: 2 · PICK THE SMALLEST MODEL THAT DOES THE JOB
sections.note: A small classifier is cheaper and more accurate on 800 rows. A small instruct model only wins if you need a written reason with each label.

sections.label: 3 · MEASURE THE BEFORE, DO NOT GUESS IT
sections.note: The untouched model gets scored on the held out set first. That is the number the fine-tuned one has to beat.

sections.label: 4 · FINE TUNE, THEN GRADE IT PER CATEGORY
sections.note: Overall accuracy can look great while Urgent is quietly missed. Per class recall is the number that matters here.

sections.label: 5 · HAND IT OVER SO YOU CAN RUN IT WITHOUT ME
sections.note: Adapter files, a one command script, and a short written summary of what was done and where it is weak.
